popCulture.title: Oedipus Rex
popCulture.creator: Sophocles
popCulture.description: Sophocles' Theban king who hunts a murderer and finds himself — the plague, the recognition, and the blindfold that still define the West's masterplot of knowledge that destroys.

popCulture.title: Oedipus
popCulture.description: The Theban who killed his father and married his mother — a name Freud made inescapable in modern culture.
